highlights.description: The defendant in a case involving chip smuggling worked with Jensen Huang’s romantic partner.

highlights.title: Matchmakers say more tech workers fear romantic espionage after the Jensen Huang scandal; an AI companion app pitches "zero espionage" executive girlfriends (Wired)
highlights.description: Wired: Matchmakers say more tech workers fear romantic espionage after the Jensen Huang scandal; an AI companion app pitches “zero espionage” executive girlfriends — The Jensen Huang scandal is the latest fuel for dating anxieties among newly rich and powerful tech workers.

highlights.title: Red wave: Xiaomi goes global with first overseas EV sales
highlights.description: As a red wave of Chinese-built electric vehicles breaks over Europe and Canada, Xiaomi is selling its electric cars outside of China for the first time ever – and its starting its push for global growth with the UAE in 2027. more…

highlights.title: Motorola Moto Tag 3 listed on Amazon
highlights.description: Motorola unveiled the Moto Tag in 2024 and followed up with the Moto Tag 2 in January this year. Considering the gap between the first and second-gen Moto Tags, we weren't expecting Motorola to launch Moto Tag 3 anytime soon, but it seems Motorola could launch it in a few months, or even weeks, as it is already listed on Amazon.
